name: Partner Dominoes Jamaican
description: Jamaican Partner Dominoes is the Jamaican variant of Latin Partnership Dominoes. Four players in partnerships, double-six set, all tiles dealt. Same base rules as Partnership Dominoes with Jamaican/ Caribbean conventions.

overview.description: Jamaican Partner Dominoes is the Jamaican variant of Latin Partnership Dominoes. Four players in partnerships, double-six set, all tiles dealt. Same base rules as Partnership Dominoes with Jamaican/ Caribbean conventions.

history.origins: Caribbean variant of Latin Partnership Dominoes. Jamaica and Puerto Rico (Chiva) have regional rules.
timeline: Present: Popular in Jamaica; often played loudly and socially.
history.cultural: Social, often loud play; part of Caribbean domino culture.
history.evolution: Caribbean and Jamaican variants share the same deal and line play; regional differences include who starts the next hand (e.g. winning team in Jamaica) and tie-breaking in blocked hands.

setup.players: 4 in fixed partnerships. Partners sit opposite.

rules.objective: Be first team to reach target (typically 100). Score by going out or winning blocked hand (fewer pips).
rules.gameplay: Same as Latin Partnership Dominoes: the double-six tile leads the first hand; play to the line; must play if possible else pass; block equals four passes; lower pips wins blocked hand. In Jamaican play the winning team typically starts the next hand and may choose which partner leads; the starter may lead any tile. If the previous hand was tied, the holder of double-six leads. A blocked hand is won by the team of the player with the fewest pips on their remaining tiles; if two opponents tie for fewest pips, the hand is a tie.
keyRules: The double-six tile leads the first hand.

strategy.basic: As Latin Partnership. Play to empty; block when possible.
strategy.intermediate: Track played tiles; coordinate with partner.
tips: See Partnership Dominoes for core strategy.

variations.name: Caribbean Conventions
variations.description: Jamaican and Puerto Rican (Chiva) differ in who starts the next hand and tie-breaking in blocked hands; see primary sources for regional details.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Regional conventions affect who leads and tie-breaks; engine uses base Jamaican rules.

scoring.description: Winners score losers' unplayed pips. Blocked: lower pip total wins.

synthesis.shortDescription: Jamaican variant of Partnership Dominoes. 4p, 7 each. See Caribbean page for details.
